store.summary: Hysteria 2 client for CardputerZero with SOCKS5 and local TUN.
store.description: Manage Hysteria 2 nodes, import and share node QR codes, and run a SOCKS5 or local TUN proxy in the background. Includes an official Hysteria core, optional auto-start and a network recovery option.

zh-CN.summary: 面向 CardputerZero 的 Hysteria 2 客户端，支持节点管理、SOCKS5 和本机 TUN。
